verdict.rationale: Loops documents composing emails in its editor, building audience segments, and sending a campaign one time to a segment. Campaign drafts can also be created via the API and then reviewed and sent from the dashboard. Scheduling a campaign for a future time is never documented, so the send-or-schedule step is only half evidenced. Missing for 10: documented campaign scheduling, in-depth first-party docs on the audience-selection step at campaign send time, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the campaign-sending flow.

support.subject: As a marketer, I can compose an email campaign, pick its audience, and send or schedule it — the arena's table-stakes loop
